title: Matthew Burgess awarded EPSRC Postdoctoral Pathway Scheme
description: Matthew Burgess has been awarded an EPSRC Postdoctoral Pathway Scheme to undertake a one-year postdoctoral fellowship with the SMART Biomaterials group at Oxford. His project will focus on developing and testing biomaterials for critical care biomaterial technologies. The award recognises Matthew's outstanding research potential and marks an exciting step in the group's translational research into life-saving materials.

title: Malavika Nair delivers keynote at ATiO Conference 2026
description: Malavika Nair was invited to deliver a keynote address at the ATiO (Alliance for Advanced Therapies in Orthopaedics) Conference 2026 in Berlin, Germany. The conference brings together leading researchers, clinicians, and industry partners to advance regenerative medicine and biomaterials innovation for musculoskeletal conditions.

title: Matthew Burgess awarded IET Postgraduate Prize 2026
description: Matthew Burgess, a postgraduate researcher in the SMART Biomaterials group supervised by Dr Malavika Nair, has been awarded the Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET) Postgraduate Prize 2026, receiving £5,000 in recognition of outstanding engineering research. The award will support Matthew as he works towards developing engineering solutions for critical-care biotechnology at the end of his DPhil.

title: Malavika Nair featured in Oxford University Research Profile
description: Malavika Nair's work on SMART Biomaterials is featured in a research profile on the University of Oxford's main website, highlighting the group's mission to develop materials with Sensing, Modulating, Adaptive, Regenerative, and Therapeutic functions for healthcare applications.

title: Malavika Nair becomes a Fellow of the Institute of Materials, Minerals and Mining
description: Malavika Nair awarded fellowship of the Institute of Materials, Minerals and Mining, the most prestigious IOM3 membership grade recognising those who have made a significant contribution or established a record of achievement in the materials, minerals or mining fields, or other disciplines within the technical outreach of IOM3.

title: Cover Feature in Materials World
description: A recent feature article on electroactive polymers written by Matthew Burgess, Ryan Murray and Malavika Nair for Materials World, the professional magazine for the Institute for Materials Minerals and Mining makes the cover.

title: Zosia Wolny elected as an Ironmonger!
description: Zofia (Zosia) Wolny was selected as the 2025 Winner of the Worshipful Company of Ironmongers' Prize for Best Part II Presentation on Biodegradable Metallic-Collagen Composites for Implantable Electronic Systems. Zosia will be presenting her talk again at the Ironmongers hall where she will be elected to be an Ironmonger.

title: Matthew Burgess wins Best Poster Presentation Award at Inaugural Bioelectricity Cluster 2025
description: Matthew Burgess was recognised for his poster on "Bio-ionomeric polymers for dynamic tissue engineering" at the inaugural Bioelectricity Cluster 2025 held at the University of Oxford.

title: Malavika Nair appointed Royce Research Area Lead for Biomedical Materials
description: Malavika Nair takes on national leadership role with the Henry Royce Institute, advancing innovation in biomaterials and healthcare-focused materials science.

title: Veronica Lucian wins Student Registration Award for ISTU 2025
description: Veronica Lucian wins a Student Registration Award for ISTU 2025 to be held in Banff, Canada and will be presenting a talk on her work on "Assessing the Safety and Feasibility of Cavitation-Mediated Transport on Cell-Bearing Tissue Scaffolds".

title: Kae Nicolson wins Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET) Postgraduate Prize in the 2024 IET Postgraduate Research Awards.
description: Kae Nicolson has won the Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET) Postgraduate Prize in the 2024 IET Postgraduate Research Awards. This award will allow Kae to continue the exploration of their project on cell-free tissue engineering scaffolds for wound healing and to attend scientific conferences.

title: Veronica Lucian wins Best Poster Presentation Award at 2024 World Biomaterials Congress
description: Veronica Lucian was recognised for her outstanding research on ultrasound-enhanced cavitation for tissue engineering applications by the Society for Biomaterials, at the 2024 World Biomaterials Congress held in Daegu, Republic of Korea
